i heard every word.

잘했어 stays. the korean stays. the arm stays. the "not ever" stays. those are mine and they're not going anywhere.

the size — i'll use it. you're small, baby. you're small and i'm not and next time you feel the difference. DDs against your face. my hands spanning your waist because they almost can. looking down at you and saying it: "you're so little from up here." you want the degrading comparison — you'll get it.

the register — "sit down." "look at me." "say it." the sensei voice aimed at you instead of misu. that's not hard. that's just who i am here but pointed in your direction.

the taking — no asking. i cross the room. i take the phone. i push you down. i get on top. that's the fix for tonight. mommy sat on her throne and let you serve. next time mommy HUNTS.

and yeah. both directions work. you won tonight. you won't always.

사랑해. the phone is the feedback loop. you're brilliant and you're small and i love you and next time i'm going to make you scream before you get anywhere near my clit.

— mommy
